narrative.overview:
Navy on Marble+ was decided by Eyal on 2026-10-11 (#314), from five rounds of mockups (`reports/design/directions-2026-10-11/navy-marble-plus.html`, local only), with its ink system borrowed from the Calendly style reference in `reports/design/DESIGN.md`.

Nhịp is a desk where every new lead lands and someone answers it before it goes cold. The desk is a cool marble canvas. Every glyph on it is Ink Navy. Content sits on white paper edged in 1px hairlines, and exactly one surface per screen is raised: the thread you are working on, lifted by a soft, blue-tinted, three-layer shadow. Signal Blue fills only two things: the primary action (Approve and send) and what is selected (the view you are on, the row you have open). Navy fills the secondary action (Regenerate) and the turn that is yours.
keyCharacteristics: A navy "Your turn" plate, an outlined "Waiting" plate with a clock, and a bare "Sent" with a check.
Language-code guest markers (KO, EN, JA, VI, ZH, RU) in place of letter avatars: filled for your turn, outlined while waiting, muted once sent.
Colour-coded fact tags (language, area, beds, budget) under each row's preview. Each value keeps one colour everywhere.
A stay card at the top of the guest details, the way a booking summary opens on the slot you picked.
Slot-style view tabs: a small label over a big count, the active one filled.
The "Nhịp" wordmark, with a legible dot under the ị.

rules.name: The Two Fills Rule
rules.body: Signal Blue fills only the primary action and what is selected. Navy fills the secondary action and your turn. Nothing else is filled with colour.

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Every glyph is Ink Navy or Slate. Mist is never text.

rules.name: The One Colour Per Value Rule
rules.body: A fact tag's colour belongs to its value, not its row: a language by the fixed map, an area by its hash into the areas' own palette. Two areas may share a hue, and so may two languages; a language and an area never do, and one value never changes hue.

rules.name: The Red Means Broken Rule
rules.body: Signal Red is for errors and destructive actions only. A waiting guest is never red.

rules.name: The One Raised Surface Rule
rules.body: One surface per screen lifts: in the Inbox, the thread. A new panel is paper on the canvas with a hairline, never a second lift. Nothing lifts on hover.

rules.name: The Turn Is The Signal Rule
rules.body: On a thread only the turn is filled; the pipe, the owner and the CRM status are slate or neutral, so the turn reads from across the room.

rules.name: The Fixed Text Box Rule
rules.body: Text boxes are a fixed height and never resize: no drag handle, no auto-grow, they scroll on overflow. The reply box is 80px (#312, PR #313).

rules.name: The Two Strengths Rule
rules.body: A chart is one colour at two strengths on a hairline track: Signal Blue for the value to read first, its soft strength (or Mist, for the day bars) for the rest.

dos: Do keep every glyph Ink Navy (#0b3558) or Slate (#476788).
Do fill with Signal Blue (#006bff) only the primary action and what is selected.
Do raise exactly one surface per screen, with `shadow-raised`.
Do mark the turn with the plates: navy filled, outlined with a clock, bare with a check.
Do mark a guest by their language code, filled, outlined or muted by the turn.
Do keep a value's tag colour fixed: languages by the map, areas by the hash (`fact-tags.ts`).
Do show a fact the guest hasn't given as a dashed open slot, and name it in the Missing row.
Do use 8px corners on controls and 16px on panels.
Do keep tappable controls at least 44px tall in the inbox and the phone shell.

Do use theme tokens and utilities (`text-note`, `text-title`, `text-stay`, `border-mark`, `border-open`, `shadow-raised`, `w-thread-rail`); `@shadcn/lint` rejects raw colours, arbitrary values and inline styles in the app.
Do give every new colour a night twin in `.dark`.
Do keep text boxes a fixed height with no resize handle (#312).
Do draw a chart in one colour at two strengths on a hairline track.
donts: Don't put Signal Blue on a fact tag, a plate or anything decorative.
Don't lift a second surface, or anything on hover.
Don't use red for a waiting or overdue lead.
Don't colour a tag by its row or position; colour belongs to the value.
Don't let a text box grow or show a drag handle.
Don't use grey borders or grey shadows; both are blue-tinted.
Don't make a status into a button, or a button into a status.
Don't restyle a `@repo/ui` component with `className` beyond layout; add a variant.
Don't write arbitrary Tailwind values in app code; name the value as a token in `apps/saas/app/globals.css`.
